'''Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd.''' is an Indian real estate and infrastructure development company headquartered in [[Mumbai]], [[India]]. The company was founded in 1994 and is part of the [[Mahindra Group]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Mahindra Lifespace plans to acquire land parcels with sales potential of Rs 2,000 crore|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/real-estate/mahindra-lifespace-plans-to-acquire-land-parcels-with-sales-potential-of-rs-2000-crore/article31826492.ece|access-date=2020-09-25|website=[[Business Line]]|date=14 June 2020 |language=en}}</ref> The company focuses on residential developments<ref>{{Cite web|last=Sapam|first=Bidya|date=2019-07-01|title=Mahindra Lifespace looks to scale up its affordable housing biz|url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/manufacturing/mahindra-lifespace-looks-to-scale-up-its-affordable-housing-biz-1561922716055.html|access-date=2020-09-25|website=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]|language=en}}</ref> and integrated cities and industrial clusters<ref>{{Cite web|last=Sapam|first=Bidya|date=2019-03-04|title=Mahindra Lifespace looks to add strategic investment partners|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/mahindra-lifespace-looks-to-add-strategic-investment-partners-1551723501555.html|access-date=2020-09-25|website=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]|language=en}}</ref> across various locations in India including [[Mumbai]], [[Pune]], [[Nagpur]], [[Ahmedabad]], [[National Capital Region (India)|Delhi NCR]], [[Jaipur]], [[Hyderabad]], [[Chennai]], and [[Bangalore|Bengaluru]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-02-07|title=Sangeeta Prasad resigns as MD, CEO of Mahindra Lifespaces|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/sangeeta-prasad-resigns-as-md-ceo-of-mahindra-lifespaces/1859865/|access-date=2020-09-25|website=The Financial Express|language=en-US}}</ref>

== History ==
GESCO Corporation Limited was incorporated as a Private Limited Company on 16 March 1999 which was converted to a Public Limited Company on 18 August 1999. GESCO was originally the real estate division of Great Eastern Shipping and was spun off into an independent company in April 1999. In 2001, GESCO Corporation and Mahindra Realty & Infrastructure Developers Ltd (MRIDL) demerged the realty and infrastructure divisions of MRIDL and merged it into GESCO.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/archive/gesco-eyes-foray-into-retail-entertainment/35422/|title=Gesco eyes foray into retail, entertainment|date=21 January 2002|newspaper=[[The Financial Express (India)|The Financial Express]]|access-date=9 April 2019}}</ref> In 2007, the Company name was changed from Mahindra GESCO Developers Limited to Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd. (MLDL)<ref>{{cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/mahindra-lifespace-developers-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-3527.cms|title=Mahindra Lifespace Developers History - Mahindra Lifespace Developers Information |newspaper=[[The Economic Times]]|access-date=9 April 2019}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==
2016: Porter Prize For Excellence In Governance by India's National Competitiveness Forum (NCF)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Winners 2016 – Porter Prize|url=https://porterprize.in/winners-2016/|access-date=2020-12-01|language=en-US}}</ref>

== Initiatives ==

=== The Mahindra Teri Centre of Excellence ===
The Mahindra Teri Centre of Excellence was developed to reduce the footprint of the real estate industry and to influence the real estate industry and its value chain to move towards innovative and sustainable development.<ref>{{Cite news|date=2016-05-20|title=Mahindra-TERI Center of Excellence|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/mahindra-teri-center-of-excellence-116052001416_1.html|access-date=2020-11-02}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Mahindra-TERI centre of excellence to develop energy-efficient technology for real estate sector|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/mahindra-teri-centre-of-excellence-to-develop-energy-efficient-technology-for-real-estate-sector/article24146466.ece|access-date=2020-11-02|website=Business Line|date=12 June 2018 |language=en}}</ref>

=== Sustainable Leadership Housing Coalition ===
MLDL is one of the founding members of the Sustainable Housing Leadership Consortium (SHLC), a private sector-led consortium founded in 2016.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=2015-10-01|title=Mahindra Lifespaces launches its 'Green Army' initiative|url=http://architectureupdate.in/mahindra-lifespaces-launches-its-green-army-initiative/|access-date=2020-11-02|website=Architecture Update|language=en-GB}}</ref>

=== Mahindra World City Jaipur ===
MWC Jaipur is a joint venture between Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd (MLDL) and Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation (RIICO). In 2015, MWCJ became the first project in Asia to receive Stage 2 Climate Positive Development certification from the C40 Cities Climate Leadership Group (C40).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mahindra World City Jaipur provides 16 acres to 4 firms for setting up facilities|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/real-estate/mahindra-world-city-jaipur-provides-16-acres-to-4-firms-for-setting-up-facilities-5458691.html|access-date=2020-11-02|website=Moneycontrol|date=25 June 2020 }}</ref>

extract: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd. is an Indian real estate and infrastructure development company headquartered in Mumbai, India. The company was founded in 1994 and is part of the Mahindra Group. The company focuses on residential developments and integrated cities and industrial clusters across various locations in India including Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Ahmedabad, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Bengaluru.
